source: monorepo@f9b7c18 Canonical Encoding and Domain Hashing §§3-10 and TaskOrder Hashing and Signing §§2-8; the node Keeper Interface Contract remains the producer/consumer source for non-core Task stage domains. TRUEOPEN_SETTLEMENT_BILL_LEAF_V1 is the ruling 32 structure-only freeze in proto/task/v1/settlement.proto.
notes: Every vector is H_FIELDS_V1: preimage = u64_be(len(domain)) || domain || for each field u64_be(len(field)) || field; digest = SHA256(preimage).

Field encoding (Canonical Encoding and Domain Hashing §§3-4): string = strict UTF-8 bytes; bytes = raw bytes, and a Hash32 is exactly 32 raw bytes, never hex text; uint32/uint64 = 4/8-byte big-endian; bool = 0x00/0x01; enum = uint32 big-endian; frame = nested FRAME_V1 with no domain prefix whose fields are the nested message fields in ascending schema field-number order.

type "address" records BOTH the Bech32 text a caller signs and the address codec bytes that are actually framed (ruling 24 / issue #95). Only the hex enters the preimage; the Bech32 column exists so a non-Go implementation can verify its own decode, and x/hub/types/testdata/hub_domains_v1.json now records the same column on its six operator_address fields, so both fixtures are self-verifying on address decoding.

The infer_evidence_commitments_v1_* vectors retain the explicit outer count and encode all EvidenceCommitmentV1 messages in one REPEATED_V1 field. Each element is a nested FRAME_V1, and the inner element_count must equal the outer count.

type optional records an explicit present boolean and zero or one encoded value. The MetricSummary, Result and DataUnavailableAggregate vectors exercise absent, present-zero and fixed-slot present/absent layouts through the production helpers.
tamper: XOR one bit of one framed field. "byte" indexes the framed field bytes and may be negative to count from the end; "bit" is the bit position inside that byte, 0 being least significant.

replay: apply the listed field overrides, keeping the frozen field type, and expect a different digest. Covers cross-chain, cross-task, cross-operator, cross-duty, cross-round, stale nonce, extended expiry, wrong schema_version, non-ASCII UTF-8, zero-hash substitution and list reorder or duplication.
rejected_by_production names a vector whose framing is published as a golden but which the production helper must REFUSE to derive; the binding gate asserts that error instead of a value match.
Regenerate with TRUEOPEN_REGEN_FIXTURES=1; the run rewrites the expectations and then fails on purpose so the diff must be reviewed against the frozen contract before it is committed.
